units.source_text: 云居雁的态度完全是一个小孩。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was behaving exactly like a child.

units.source_text: 父亲对她劝说了千言万语，她也不听从，弄得父亲哭了起来。

en.t: Her father pleaded with her at great length, but she would not listen, and in the end she made him weep.

units.source_text: 他只能私下和几个可靠的侍女商量：“有何办法可使小姐不致埋没一生呢？”

en.t: He could only consult in private with a few trustworthy gentlewomen, asking, "Is there any way to keep the young lady from wasting her whole life in obscurity?"
He did nothing but blame the old lady.

units.source_text: 太君对孙女和外孙都很疼爱。

en.t: The old lady dearly loved both her granddaughter and her daughter's son.

units.source_text: 而对夕雾大概疼爱更甚吧，看见他这点年纪已经懂得爱情，觉得可喜，却怪内大臣所说的话不通情理。

en.t: But she was probably even fonder of Yugiri; seeing that he already understood love at such a young age, she found it charming, and instead thought the Minister of the Interior's words unreasonable.

units.source_text: 她想：“何必如此大惊小怪！

en.t: She thought, "Why make such a great fuss over it!

units.source_text: 内大臣对云居雁本来不很关怀，并不想好好地教养她，使她将来入宫。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior never cared very much for Kumoi no Kari in the first place, nor did he intend to raise her properly so that she might enter palace service one day.

units.source_text: 大约后来看见我如此重视她，才发心要她入宫当皇太子妃吧。

en.t: Most likely, only after he saw how highly I valued her did he decide that she should enter the palace and become the Crown Prince's consort.

units.source_text: 如果这希望落了空，命里注定要嫁给臣下，那么除了夕雾之外，哪有更强的人呢？

en.t: If that hope comes to nothing, and fate means she must marry a subject, then apart from Yugiri, where could there be a better man?

units.source_text: 无论从相貌、姿态哪一方面说来，有谁赶得上夕雾呢？

en.t: Whether in looks or bearing, who could possibly compare with Yugiri?

units.source_text: 照我看来，他娶云居雁是委屈的，应该和身份更高的人攀亲才是。”

en.t: As I see it, marrying Kumoi no Kari would be beneath him; he ought to form a match with someone of even higher rank."

units.source_text: 想是对夕雾疼爱太甚之故吧，她也怪怨内大臣了。

en.t: Perhaps because she loved Yugiri too much, she too began to resent the Minister of the Interior.

units.source_text: 内大臣如果知道了她的心思，一定更加恨她。

en.t: If the Minister of the Interior had known what was in her heart, he would surely have hated her all the more.
